property_summary: After any Put(t) of any amount, the account cannot withdraw immediately: Collect must leave the balance unchanged because the stored unlockTime is at least the current block timestamp; the mutant stores past t directly, so a Collect succeeds right away and drains the balance for some fuzzed t and amount.
change_summary: Replace the clamped unlockTime computation with a direct assignment so a past _unlockTime can be stored, changing Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime after Put.
